in_marathi.name: Hariharan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Hari: Hare Krishna, Hara: Remover of sorrows
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hariharan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hariharan is a Sanskrit name derived from the words Hari and Hara. Hari, which means Hare Krishna, symbolizes the divine deity Vishnu, and Hara represents Shiva, the remover of sorrows. The name Hariharan thus signifies the union of these two powerful deities. This name is commonly used in Hindu culture and holds significant spiritual significance.
